ciso-agent-security version 1.0.0

- Initial release of an AI agent cybersecurity skill for red team patrols and defense.
- Implements MITRE ATLAS, OWASP Top 10 (LLM and Agentic), CSA MAESTRO, NIST AI RMF, and Gray Swan frameworks.
- Defines standardized patrol procedures, posture scoring, quarantine enforcement, and patch recommendations for AI agent systems.
- Ensures all vulnerability assessments and testing are mapped to official frameworks and sources only.
